notes.title: Demo 1.3.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Fixed minor light flickering bug.
 Fixed minor music volume bug.
 Small performance improvements across the board.

notes.title: Demo 1.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hello Sufferers,

Patch 1.3 is here with some major changes to the rabbit movement as well as many bug fixes and improvements that include: 


 Fixed a bug that prevents music volume from changing
 Added the option to change the bully commentator volume
 Balancing changes: increased all the starting resources
 Added the ability to fly without jumping (Experimental)
 Added the ability to run backward (Experimental)
 Added a live map view (Experimental)

Keep the feedback coming on everything, especially the experimental features!
